build_tbb_release_debug: build Intel TBB release and debug binaries using make or msbuild with configurable build prefix
install_tbb_libs: install TBB shared libraries including tbb, tbbmalloc, and tbbmalloc_proxy to the target prefix directory
install_tbb_devel: install TBB development files including debug libraries, PDB files, linker scripts, and header files
install_tbb_python: install the TBB Python module and RML library by building and installing python/setup.py with TBBROOT set
install_tbb_docs: install TBB documentation files including CHANGES, LICENSE, README, and Release_Notes to the share doc directory
